definitions.explanation: An electrical fault where current flows along an unintended path, bypassing the normal circuit.

definitions.gloss: jumping to conclusions; hasty reasoning; oversimplification
definitions.explanation: Thinking that skips logical steps and reaches a conclusion too quickly, often resulting in an incorrect or shallow judgment.

notes:
{短絡|たんらく} literally means "short connection" — ⟦{短|たん}→短〜：03959_tan⟧ (short) + {絡|らく} (connection, entanglement).

The figurative sense (sense 2) is more commonly encountered in everyday use, particularly through the na-adjective form ⟦{短絡的|たんらくてき}→短絡的：20703_tanrakuteki⟧ (simplistic, hasty in reasoning). The metaphor mirrors the English concept of a "short circuit" in thinking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{短絡的|たんらくてき}→短絡的：20703_tanrakuteki⟧な⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧ (simplistic thinking)
- ⟦{短絡的|たんらくてき}→短絡的：20703_tanrakuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧ (to judge hastily)
- {短絡|たんらく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to short-circuit; to jump to conclusions)
